turns.user: Can we buy the 5-litre gaskets from a supplier that doesn't have a food-grade certificate? Their price is much better.
turns.agent:
No. Gaskets come into contact with food and may be bought only from a supplier holding a valid food-grade certificate on file in Bahi. Additionally, a cheaper quotation does not by itself justify changing suppliers for a food-contact part.

Source: Purchase Policy §6.2; Purchase Policy §6.4
